scope: Serpent Rivals props. Every sprite: draw its drawSize (game units) with `anchor` (units from the sprite top-left) on the model point named in `use`. `contact` = [x, y, w, h] in sprite units = the model rect, so collision matches the drawing. Blender Cycles, Vault ortho rig, AgX Medium High Contrast.

chamber_floor.use: Clash Chamber floor (scenery, floors 2-3): anchor = centre of m.chamber rect; draw under heads, balls, effects. No collision (the chamber is open space). Kerb inner edge = contact inset 6u.

clash_0.use: Clash impact (effect `clash`), centred on the effect point (chamber cx, cy). Frames 0,1,2 over the first ~0.3 s (e.g. 0.08/0.10/0.12 s), additive-free normal blending; scale 1.0-1.15 for punch.

clash_1.use: Clash impact (effect `clash`), centred on the effect point (chamber cx, cy). Frames 0,1,2 over the first ~0.3 s (e.g. 0.08/0.10/0.12 s), additive-free normal blending; scale 1.0-1.15 for punch.

clash_2.use: Clash impact (effect `clash`), centred on the effect point (chamber cx, cy). Frames 0,1,2 over the first ~0.3 s (e.g. 0.08/0.10/0.12 s), additive-free normal blending; scale 1.0-1.15 for punch.

lure_gnash_dim.use: emerald rune lure (gnash); draw centred on the lure rect (anchor = rect centre). Dim: lure.lit false / cooling, cold.

lure_gnash_lit.use: emerald rune lure (gnash); draw centred on the lure rect (anchor = rect centre). Lit: lure.lit true, glows.

lure_mooncoil_dim.use: violet rune lure (mooncoil); draw centred on the lure rect (anchor = rect centre). Dim: lure.lit false / cooling, cold.

lure_mooncoil_lit.use: violet rune lure (mooncoil); draw centred on the lure rect (anchor = rect centre). Lit: lure.lit true, glows.

seal_crack1.use: Twin Seal door; anchor = centre of m.seal rect (x + w/2, y + h/2). Stage by HP fraction: intact > 0.75, crack1 > 0.5, crack2 > 0.25, shattered otherwise (and under seal-open/seal-shatter).

seal_crack2.use: Twin Seal door; anchor = centre of m.seal rect (x + w/2, y + h/2). Stage by HP fraction: intact > 0.75, crack1 > 0.5, crack2 > 0.25, shattered otherwise (and under seal-open/seal-shatter).

seal_intact.use: Twin Seal door; anchor = centre of m.seal rect (x + w/2, y + h/2). Stage by HP fraction: intact > 0.75, crack1 > 0.5, crack2 > 0.25, shattered otherwise (and under seal-open/seal-shatter).

seal_shattered.use: Twin Seal door; anchor = centre of m.seal rect (x + w/2, y + h/2). Stage by HP fraction: intact > 0.75, crack1 > 0.5, crack2 > 0.25, shattered otherwise (and under seal-open/seal-shatter).

shutter_eyes.use: Mooncoil eyes behind the shutter slats (registered with window kit, eye line 4.2u above the opening centre). Visible through the broken slat and gaps; fade/blink with alpha.

ward_plate_gilt.use: Seal ward plate (one per seal.ward), anchor at a sealWardSlots point. Optional gilt variant: alternate with iron, or use for the newest plate.

ward_plate_iron.use: Seal ward plate (one per seal.ward), anchor at a sealWardSlots point. Default plate.

window_front_shuttered.use: Floor-1 Mooncoil window, closed (m.shutters). Same drawSize/anchor/opening as assets/castle/window_front: draw window_back, then shutter_eyes (optional, blink by alpha), then this, at the window centre. Not a lunge window.

sealWardSlots.note: ward plate centres in seal sprite units (from the seal sprite top-left), in fill order; draw plate i < seal.ward at slot i with the plate anchor. Plate contact is visual only (the seal rect owns collision).
